CandidateEntry.description: One evaluated v2 candidate: its I2 summary and **every** admitted pair (D4, D10).
CandidateEntry.title: CandidateEntry

CandidateLimitationCode.description: The internal I2 limitation codes (D4, D13.4, D14.1), carried unchanged.
CandidateLimitationCode.title: CandidateLimitationCode

CapturedWorkloadKind.description: I2 D14.1: the captured Kubernetes kind exactly.
CapturedWorkloadKind.title: CapturedWorkloadKind

CapturedWorkloadRef.description:
The I2 `CapturedWorkload` as resolved by one pair or candidate. `uid` is null only when the
capture carried none (`WORKLOAD_UID_UNAVAILABLE`, I2 D14.1).
CapturedWorkloadRef.title: CapturedWorkloadRef

ComparedMembership.description:
A `(provider Service or unresolved owner, Operation)` membership positive in one scope.
`provider_service_id` is null when the owner is unresolved (D8).
ComparedMembership.title: ComparedMembership

Comparison.description:
D10 comparison of two selected scopes. Labels mean "positively evidenced here", never
"absent there".
Comparison.title: Comparison

Completeness.description: Relative to the evaluated inventory only (I3 §7, §9); never "the system was observed".
Completeness.title: Completeness

EvaluatedSource.description: A capture source that formed at least one pair (D10 `evaluated_sources`).
EvaluatedSource.title: EvaluatedSource

EvidenceEntry.description: One requested ref (D11). A `NOT_FOUND` entry never says why.
EvidenceEntry.title: EvidenceEntry

EvidenceRecord.description:
v0.4.0 I2.1 - spec §11.2. `evidence_type`/`source_type` reuse the existing
`app.provenance.model` enums rather than redefining them - no new adapter classification.
EvidenceRecord.title: EvidenceRecord

EvidenceRefKind.description: D11: what a resolved ref is.
EvidenceRefKind.title: EvidenceRefKind

EvidenceRelationType.description:
v0.4.0 I2.1 - the closed set of canonical graph relation kinds (spec §11.2's `supports`),
widened by I3 (DEPLOYED_AS) and v0.5.0 I4 (PUBLISHES_TO/SUBSCRIPTION_OF). Deliberately its own
closed enum rather than reusing `DeliveryRelationType` (only the delivery relations) or a
graph-layer string - `get_evidence` describes existing facts, never a new architecture claim.
EvidenceRelationType.title: EvidenceRelationType

InventoryBounds.description: The D4 values actually applied to this answer page.
InventoryBounds.title: InventoryBounds

LocalDisposition.description: I1 §10 / I2 dispositions, carried unchanged inside the payload (never envelope outcomes).
LocalDisposition.title: LocalDisposition

LocalQualification.description: I2 D14.4: every assertion has v2, so only these two are reachable.
LocalQualification.title: LocalQualification

LocalityLimitation.description: `reasons` carries the I2 `LOCALITY_*` codes behind the limitation, if any.
LocalityLimitation.title: LocalityLimitation

LocalityLimitationCode.description: D9: the closed 0.6 envelope codes, separate from the 0.5 `LimitationCode`.
LocalityLimitationCode.title: LocalityLimitationCode

LocalityRequestContext.description:
The normalized, evaluated request (D3, D10). An evaluated request is supported, so its
relation, dimensions and days are the supported forms.
LocalityRequestContext.title: LocalityRequestContext

LocalityWorkload.description: A positive caller Workload: its exact identity plus presentation-only name/logical id.
LocalityWorkload.title: LocalityWorkload

ObservedEvidenceMetadata.description:
v0.4.0 I2.1 - spec §11.2: bounded observed-evidence metadata only. No raw payloads,
authorization values, full spans, baggage, resource attributes, or sample trace ids.
ObservedEvidenceMetadata.title: ObservedEvidenceMetadata

OperationAssessment.description:
One I2 `QualifiedLocalEvidenceAssessment`, values unchanged. The subject, relation,
environment, window, caller Workload and snapshot are carried once by the containing locality,
request context and envelope (D16.3).
OperationAssessment.title: OperationAssessment

PairEntry.description:
One admitted (candidate, source) pair, unchanged from I2 (D13). Only an `APPLICABLE` pair
carries a resolved Workload (`_phase_4`).
PairEntry.title: PairEntry

ProviderGroup.description: D8: one provider Service in one caller Workload. No group-level qualification.
ProviderGroup.title: ProviderGroup

ProviderOwnerReason.description: D8: zero or several evidenced `PROVIDES` owners.
ProviderOwnerReason.title: ProviderOwnerReason

ScopeEvaluation.description: D10: a selected identity's status, derived only from the evaluated inventory.
ScopeEvaluation.title: ScopeEvaluation

ScopedV2Record.description: D11: the admitted public fields of one `ScopedObservedCallV2` (v2 contract §1, §3).
ScopedV2Record.title: ScopedV2Record

SourceLimitation.description: A non-applicable pair of a contributing candidate (I2 `source_limitations`).
SourceLimitation.title: SourceLimitation

SupportedFact.description:
v0.4.0 I2.1 - spec §11.2: one existing canonical relation fact an evidence record supports.
Not a generic graph record and not a new architecture claim - only the 3 bounded fields.
SupportedFact.title: SupportedFact

WorkloadIdentity.description:
D3: an exact captured caller Workload. The captured UID is required; `name` is never part of
the identity.
WorkloadIdentity.title: WorkloadIdentity

description:
The 0.6 envelope (D2, D9). `data` is null exactly for a refusal that evaluated nothing; an
evaluated `NOT_ANSWERED` still carries its inventory or entries.
title: LocalityAnswer
